content.json:
## Atlas Relay
**Operations** shows the API, errors, availability and transfers. **Traffic** shows how visitors arrive and what they do: pages, referring sites, campaigns, countries, devices and the pledge funnel.

API requests (`AppRequests`) and log lines (`AppTraces`) come from the Functions host. Page views, load times, browser errors, the API calls the browser made and the actions it counts (`AppPageViews`, `AppBrowserTimings`, `AppExceptions`, `AppDependencies`, `AppEvents`, role `web`) come from the site's own pages. `AppAvailabilityResults` is the home page test. Times are UTC. The saved queries in `ops/queries` (run with `scripts/logs.sh`) show the same data from a terminal.

content.query:
// Each source is a fuzzy union with an empty fallback of the same shape, so the tiles render
// even where a table has not been created yet.
let pageViewCount = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
    (AppPageViews | summarize n = tolong(sum(ItemCount))), (datatable(n: long)[])
    | summarize sum(n));
let browserErrorCount = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
    (AppExceptions | where AppRoleName == "web" | summarize n = tolong(sum(ItemCount))), (datatable(n: long)[])
    | summarize sum(n));
let availabilityPct = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
    (AppAvailabilityResults | summarize ok = countif(Success == true), total = count()), (datatable(ok: long, total: long)[])
    | summarize ok = sum(ok), total = sum(total)
    | project iff(total == 0, real(null), 100.0 * ok / total));
AppRequests
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount), Server5xx = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500), P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95)
| mv-expand Tile = pack_array(
    pack("Name", "Page views", "Value", todouble(coalesce(pageViewCount, 0))),
    pack("Name", "API requests", "Value", todouble(Requests)),
    pack("Name", "API 5xx, %", "Value", iff(Requests == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Server5xx / Requests, 2))),
    pack("Name", "API p95, ms", "Value", round(coalesce(P95, 0.0), 0)),
    pack("Name", "Browser errors", "Value", todouble(coalesce(browserErrorCount, 0))),
    pack("Name", "Home page availability, %", "Value", round(availabilityPct, 2)))
| project Name = tostring(Tile.Name), Value = todouble(Tile.Value)
// No availability tile until the test has run.
| where isnotnull(Value)
content.title: In the time range

content.query:
AppPageViews
| summarize Views = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Page = Name
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Page views by page

content.query:
AppRequests
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Function = Name
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: API requests by function

content.query:
let timings = AppBrowserTimings
    | summarize Loads = sum(ItemCount), P50LoadMs = round(percentile(TotalDurationMs, 50)),
        P95LoadMs = round(percentile(TotalDurationMs, 95)) by Page = Name;
AppPageViews
| summarize Views = sum(ItemCount), PageLoads = dcount(SessionId) by Page = Name
| join kind=leftouter timings on Page
| project Page, Views, PageLoads, Loads, P50LoadMs, P95LoadMs
| order by Views desc
content.title: Pages: views and load times (first page of each visit)

content.query:
AppRequests
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Status = strcat(substring(ResultCode, 0, 1), "xx")
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: API requests by status class

content.query:
AppRequests
| summarize P95ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Function = Name
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: API p95 latency by function, ms

content.query:
AppRequests
| summarize
    Requests = sum(ItemCount),
    Client4xx = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) between (400 .. 499)),
    Server5xx = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500),
    P50ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 1),
    P95ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1),
    MaxMs = round(max(DurationMs), 1)
    by Function = Name
| order by Requests desc
content.title: API requests and latency by function

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "web"
| summarize
    Calls = sum(ItemCount),
    Failures = sumif(ItemCount, Success == false),
    P50ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 1),
    P95ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1)
    by Call = Name, Status = ResultCode
| order by Calls desc
content.title: API calls as the browser saw them

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where AppRoleName == "web"
| summarize Count = sum(ItemCount), PageLoads = dcount(SessionId), Latest = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Message = OuterMessage
| order by Latest desc
content.title: Browser errors by message

content.query:
AppTraces
| where SeverityLevel >= 3
| where Message !startswith "Executed '"
| extend e = parse_json(iff(Message startswith "{", Message, "{}"))
| extend Text = iff(isempty(tostring(e.message)), substring(Message, 0, 300), tostring(e.message))
| summarize Count = count(), Latest = max(TimeGenerated) by Message = Text, Error = tostring(e.error)
| order by Latest desc
content.title: API error log lines by message

content.query:
let browser = AppExceptions
    | where AppRoleName == "web"
    | summarize Count = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
    | extend Kind = "browser errors";
let api5xx = AppRequests
    | where toint(ResultCode) >= 500
    | summarize Count = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
    | extend Kind = "API 5xx";
let apiLogs = AppTraces
    | where SeverityLevel >= 3 and Message !startswith "Executed '"
    | summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
    | extend Kind = "API error lines";
union browser, api5xx, apiLogs
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Errors over time

content.query:
AppAvailabilityResults
| summarize Availability = round(100.0 * countif(Success == true) / count(), 2) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Location
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Home page availability by location, %

content.query:
AppAvailabilityResults
| where Success == false
| project TimeGenerated, Location, DurationMs = round(DurationMs), Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Failed test runs

content.json:
### RIPE Atlas and Table Storage
One log line per outbound call from the API. For RIPE Atlas, a 4xx is an answer (a refused transfer, a key without the permission) and counts as a success; `timeout`, `network` and 5xx are failures.

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message has '"event":"dependency"' and Message has '"type":"RIPE Atlas"'
| extend e = parse_json(Message)
| summarize Calls = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Result = iff(tobool(e.success), "answered", "no answer")
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: RIPE Atlas calls

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message has '"event":"dependency"' and Message has '"type":"RIPE Atlas"'
| extend e = parse_json(Message)
| summarize
    Calls = count(),
    Failures = countif(tobool(e.success) == false),
    P50ms = percentile(toint(e.durationMs), 50),
    P95ms = percentile(toint(e.durationMs), 95),
    Latest = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Call = tostring(e.name), Result = tostring(e.resultCode)
| order by Calls desc
content.title: RIPE Atlas calls by path and result

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message has '"event":"transfer"'
| extend e = parse_json(Message)
| where tostring(e.event) == "transfer"
| summarize Transfers = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Outcome = tostring(e.outcome)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: API transfers by outcome

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message has '"event":"dependency"' and Message has '"type":"Table Storage"'
| extend e = parse_json(Message)
| summarize
    Calls = count(),
    Failures = countif(tobool(e.success) == false),
    P50ms = percentile(toint(e.durationMs), 50),
    P95ms = percentile(toint(e.durationMs), 95)
    by Operation = tostring(e.name), Result = tostring(e.resultCode)
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Table Storage requests by operation and result

content.json: A page load is one visit to the site in one browser tab. The site sets no cookies and gives visitors no id, so someone who comes back tomorrow, or opens a second tab, counts again; there is no count of unique or returning visitors. Known bots and headless browsers are left out. Visitors who block Application Insights are not counted at all, which is why the API's own counts (marked API) can be higher than the browser's. Search terms are in Google Search Console, not here. docs/RUNBOOK.md, "Traffic", explains each number. Times are UTC.

content.query:
// Each source is a fuzzy union with an empty fallback of the same shape, summarized inside the leg,
// so the tiles render before any page view or action has arrived.
let notBot = (b: string) { not(b contains "bot" or b contains "crawler" or b contains "spider" or b startswith "HeadlessChrome") };
let loads = union isfuzzy=true
        (AppPageViews
            | summarize Views = tolong(sum(ItemCount)),
                External = max(toint(tostring(Properties.referrerOrigin) !in ("", "internal", "direct"))),
                Tagged = max(toint(isnotempty(tostring(Properties.utm_source)) or isnotempty(tostring(Properties.utm_medium)) or isnotempty(tostring(Properties.utm_campaign))))
                by SessionId, ClientBrowser),
        (datatable(SessionId: string, ClientBrowser: string, Views: long, External: int, Tagged: int)[])
    | extend Human = notBot(ClientBrowser);
let pledges = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
    (AppEvents | where AppRoleName == "web" and Name == "pledge-completed" and notBot(ClientBrowser) | summarize n = tolong(sum(ItemCount))), (datatable(n: long)[])
    | summarize sum(n));
let posted = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
    (AppRequests | where Name == "projects-create" and ResultCode == "201" | summarize n = tolong(sum(ItemCount))), (datatable(n: long)[])
    | summarize sum(n));
loads
| summarize PageLoads = countif(Human), Views = sumif(Views, Human), External = countif(Human and External == 1),
    Tagged = countif(Human and Tagged == 1), BotViews = sumif(Views, not(Human))
| mv-expand Tile = pack_array(
    pack("Name", "Page loads", "Value", PageLoads),
    pack("Name", "Page views", "Value", coalesce(Views, 0)),
    pack("Name", "From another site", "Value", External),
    pack("Name", "From a tagged link", "Value", Tagged),
    pack("Name", "Pledges made (browser)", "Value", coalesce(pledges, 0)),
    pack("Name", "Projects posted (API)", "Value", coalesce(posted, 0)),
    pack("Name", "Bot and headless page views (left out)", "Value", coalesce(BotViews, 0)))
| project Name = tostring(Tile.Name), Value = todouble(Tile.Value)
content.title: In the time range

content.query:
let notBot = (b: string) { not(b contains "bot" or b contains "crawler" or b contains "spider" or b startswith "HeadlessChrome") };
union isfuzzy=true
    (AppPageViews
        | where notBot(ClientBrowser)
        | summarize ["Page views"] = tolong(sum(ItemCount)), ["Page loads"] = dcount(SessionId) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)),
    (datatable(Day: datetime, ["Page views"]: long, ["Page loads"]: long)[])
| order by Day asc
content.title: Page views and page loads per day

content.query:
// Pages by path, so each project page is its own row. Paths never carry a query string.
let notBot = (b: string) { not(b contains "bot" or b contains "crawler" or b contains "spider" or b startswith "HeadlessChrome") };
union isfuzzy=true
    (AppPageViews
        | where notBot(ClientBrowser)
        | summarize Views = tolong(sum(ItemCount)), PageLoads = dcount(SessionId)
            by Path = coalesce(trim_end("/", tostring(parse_url(Url).Path)), "/")),
    (datatable(Path: string, Views: long, PageLoads: long)[])
| top 25 by Views
content.title: Top pages

content.query:
// The first page of each page load, and how that page load arrived.
let notBot = (b: string) { not(b contains "bot" or b contains "crawler" or b contains "spider" or b startswith "HeadlessChrome") };
union isfuzzy=true
    (AppPageViews
        | where notBot(ClientBrowser)
        | summarize arg_min(TimeGenerated, Url, Properties) by SessionId
        | summarize PageLoads = count(), Direct = countif(tostring(Properties.referrerOrigin) == "direct"),
            FromAnotherSite = countif(tostring(Properties.referrerOrigin) !in ("", "internal", "direct"))
            by Path = coalesce(trim_end("/", tostring(parse_url(Url).Path)), "/")),
    (datatable(Path: string, PageLoads: long, Direct: long, FromAnotherSite: long)[])
| top 25 by PageLoads
content.title: Landing pages (first page of each page load)
Referring sites

content.query:
// Page loads that arrived through a link tagged with utm_source, utm_medium or utm_campaign, e.g.
// https://www.atlasrelay.org/?utm_source=ripe-atlas-list. "-" is a tag the link did not carry.
let notBot = (b: string) { not(b contains "bot" or b contains "crawler" or b contains "spider" or b startswith "HeadlessChrome") };
union isfuzzy=true
    (AppPageViews
        | where notBot(ClientBrowser)
        | extend Source = tostring(Properties.utm_source), Medium = tostring(Properties.utm_medium), Campaign = tostring(Properties.utm_campaign)
        | where isnotempty(Source) or isnotempty(Medium) or isnotempty(Campaign)
        | summarize PageLoads = dcount(SessionId), Views = tolong(sum(ItemCount))
            by Source = coalesce(Source, "-"), Medium = coalesce(Medium, "-"), Campaign = coalesce(Campaign, "-")),
    (datatable(Source: string, Medium: string, Campaign: string, PageLoads: long, Views: long)[])
| top 25 by PageLoads
content.title: Campaigns (utm tags)

content.query:
// Location comes from the IP address when the data arrives; the address itself is not stored.
let notBot = (b: string) { not(b contains "bot" or b contains "crawler" or b contains "spider" or b startswith "HeadlessChrome") };
union isfuzzy=true
    (AppPageViews
        | where notBot(ClientBrowser)
        | summarize PageLoads = dcount(SessionId), Views = tolong(sum(ItemCount))
            by Country = coalesce(ClientCountryOrRegion, "(unknown)")),
    (datatable(Country: string, PageLoads: long, Views: long)[])
| top 25 by PageLoads
content.title: Countries

content.query:
// Device type from the operating system (iOS and Android count as mobile), and the browser without
// its version. App Insights reports every browser as ClientType "PC", so that column is not used.
let notBot = (b: string) { not(b contains "bot" or b contains "crawler" or b contains "spider" or b startswith "HeadlessChrome") };
union isfuzzy=true
    (AppPageViews
        | where notBot(ClientBrowser)
        | summarize PageLoads = dcount(SessionId), Views = tolong(sum(ItemCount))
            by Device = iff(ClientOS has_any ("iOS", "Android") or ClientModel in ("iPhone", "iPad"), "Mobile", "Desktop"),
            Browser = coalesce(extract(@"^(.*?)[ \d.]*$", 1, ClientBrowser), ClientBrowser, "(unknown)")),
    (datatable(Device: string, Browser: string, PageLoads: long, Views: long)[])
| order by PageLoads desc
content.title: Device type and browser
Pledge funnel and other actions

content.query:
// From the API (201 answers from projects-create), so it counts every project, including those
// posted from a browser that sent no telemetry. Weeks start on Sunday (UTC).
union isfuzzy=true
    (AppRequests
        | where Name == "projects-create" and ResultCode == "201"
        | summarize ["Projects posted"] = tolong(sum(ItemCount)) by Week = startofweek(TimeGenerated)),
    (datatable(Week: datetime, ["Projects posted"]: long)[])
| order by Week asc
content.title: Projects posted per week (API)

content.query:
// What page loads went on to do, by how they arrived: the utm_source when the link carried one,
// otherwise the referring site. Browser counts only.
let notBot = (b: string) { not(b contains "bot" or b contains "crawler" or b contains "spider" or b startswith "HeadlessChrome") };
let arrivals = union isfuzzy=true
        (AppPageViews
            | where notBot(ClientBrowser)
            | extend Referrer = tostring(Properties.referrerOrigin), Source = tostring(Properties.utm_source)
            | summarize Source = take_any(Source), External = take_anyif(Referrer, Referrer != "internal"), Any = take_any(Referrer),
                ProjectViews = tolong(countif(Name == "/projects/:id"))
                by SessionId),
        (datatable(SessionId: string, Source: string, External: string, Any: string, ProjectViews: long)[])
    | extend Arrived = case(isnotempty(Source), strcat("utm_source=", Source), isnotempty(External), External,
        Any == "internal", "internal", "(not recorded)");
let actions = union isfuzzy=true
        (AppEvents
            | where AppRoleName == "web"
            | summarize Started = tolong(countif(Name == "pledge-started")), Completed = tolong(countif(Name == "pledge-completed")),
                Posted = tolong(countif(Name == "project-posted")), SignIns = tolong(countif(Name == "sign-in-clicked"))
                by SessionId),
        (datatable(SessionId: string, Started: long, Completed: long, Posted: long, SignIns: long)[]);
arrivals
| join kind=leftouter actions on SessionId
| summarize PageLoads = count(), ["Project page views"] = sum(ProjectViews), ["Sign-ins"] = sum(coalesce(SignIns, 0)),
    ["Pledges started"] = sum(coalesce(Started, 0)), ["Pledges made"] = sum(coalesce(Completed, 0)),
    ["Projects posted"] = sum(coalesce(Posted, 0))
    by Arrived
| top 25 by PageLoads
content.title: What page loads did, by how they arrived
